messages.body_plain:
Dear colleagues,

Registration is open for the Transmitting Science live online course 
"Introduction to R: starting from scratch".

Course webpage:
https://www.transmittingscience.com/courses/statistics-and-bioinformatics/introduction-r/ 
[1]

Course overview:
This course offers a hands-on introduction to R for people who have 
never used it before. Through live-coding demonstrations, guided 
exercises, and practical examples, participants will get comfortable 
navigating R, working with real data, and writing their own code -- 
building a foundation that carries directly into their own research.
Beyond the basics of R syntax and data structures, the course also 
introduces good coding practices for reproducible and efficient 
workflows, and equips participants to troubleshoot problems and make the 
most of the wider R community.

Highlights:

  	* R and RStudio orientation (data structures, packages, functions)
  	* Reading and inspecting data
  	* Data management (cleaning, subsetting, summarising, joining)
  	* Data visualisation with ggplot2
  	* Writing custom functions

For queries, please write to courses at transmittingscience.com.

Best regards,

Sole

-- 
Soledad De Esteban-Trivigno, PhD
Director
Transmitting Science
www.transmittingscience.com/courses
